seo.title: Farm OS | The Operating System Behind AfriNuts Export | Custom Agritech
seo.description: Farm OS is the custom-built operating system powering AfriNuts Export — offline-first Android app, real-time dashboards, block-level traceability, and institutional-grade reporting. Built for West African agriculture.

hero.subtitle: Proprietary Technology
hero.title:
Farm OS
The Operating System Behind AfriNuts Export
hero.lead: Every cashew we ship is tracked by software we built ourselves. An offline-first Android application with cloud synchronization, real-time dashboards, and institutional-grade reporting. This is not a farm management app we bought. This is the platform we engineered to prove what we do.
hero.cardTitle: Not an App We Bought. A Platform We Built.
hero.cardBody: An offline-first Android application with cloud synchronization, real-time dashboards, and institutional-grade reporting. Every cashew we ship is tracked by software we engineered ourselves — because off-the-shelf farm software couldn't do what our buyers and investors needed.

whyBuilt.title: Why We Built Farm OS
whyBuilt.subtitle: Most West African farms track production on paper or in WhatsApp messages. That wasn't good enough for our buyers or our investors. So we built the solution.

cards.old: Paper logs lost in the rain
cards.new: Digital records synced to the cloud automatically
Real-time dashboard with KPIs, photos, and financials
Block-level GPS coordinates, harvest dates, quality metrics

steps.title: Field
steps.desc: Worker logs task on Android app. Works offline — no internet required.

steps.title: Cloud Sync
steps.desc: Data syncs automatically when connectivity returns. Encrypted and backed up.

steps.title: Dashboard
steps.desc: Farm managers view real-time operations, financials, and KPIs.

steps.title: Stakeholders
steps.desc: Investors and buyers access verified reports and traceability data.

items.title: Block-Level Tracking
items.desc: 35 blocks mapped by row, column, GPS coordinates, survival rate, and planting date. Every tree accounted for.

items.title: Task Management
items.desc: Assign, track, and verify farm tasks. Workers log completion on Android devices — online or offline.

items.title: Photo Documentation
items.desc: Field photos attached to blocks, tasks, and expenses. Visual verification of every operation.

items.title: Expense Tracking
items.desc: Log expenses per block or farm-wide with digital receipt capture. Know exactly where every FCFA goes.

items.title: Revenue Tracking
items.desc: Record sales by batch, quality grade, and buyer. Real-time P&L per hectare.

items.title: Investor Dashboard
items.desc: Live KPIs, profit projections, and dividend tracking. The same data our team uses — not a quarterly PDF.

items.title: Batch Traceability
items.desc: Every shipment linked to a unique batch ID with full harvest-to-container documentation.

items.title: Certification Audit Trail
items.desc: Digital records of every input, inspection, and compliance check — audit-ready on demand.

items.title: Offline-First Sync
items.desc: Works without internet. Data syncs automatically when connectivity returns. Built for rural West Africa.

comparison.title: Why We Built Farm OS Instead of Buying
comparison.subtitle: We evaluated off-the-shelf farm management software. None of them solved our actual problems. So we built the solution ourselves.

rows.problem: Requires constant internet — useless in rural Odienné
rows.solution: Offline-first — works in remote fields, syncs when connected

rows.problem: Designed for large Western farms with different needs
rows.solution: Built specifically for our 35-hectare West African operation
Built in-house — zero marginal cost per user
Custom dashboards for investors, buyers, and farm managers

rows.problem: No batch traceability from harvest to container
rows.solution: End-to-end traceability — every batch tracked from field to export

comparison.footer: And one more thing: we own the code. No vendor lock-in. No price increases. Full control.

builtForAfrica.title: Built for West Africa. Not Adapted for It.
builtForAfrica.body: Farm OS was built for the reality of rural Côte d'Ivoire — works offline, syncs automatically when connectivity returns, optimized for low-bandwidth environments, and runs on affordable Android devices. This is not Silicon Valley software retrofitted for Africa. This is African software built for African conditions.

forBuyers.title: For Wholesale Buyers
forBuyers.quote: Most suppliers send a certificate. We send the data that generated it.
forBuyers.body: When you order from AfriNuts, the traceability report is pulled directly from Farm OS — not created after the fact by someone in an office. Same system our farm managers use. Same data our investors see.

forInvestors.title: For Investors
forInvestors.body: Farm OS provides real-time visibility: trees alive, expenses per hectare, revenue by quality, profit projections. This is the same dashboard our team uses daily — not a quarterly PDF written for fundraising.

roadmap.title: What's Coming: Farm OS v2
roadmap.subtitle: Our roadmap is driven by buyer demand, investor requirements, and operational needs. Each phase builds on the previous one.

items.title: Quality Metrics Dashboard
items.desc: Moisture content, nut count, defective rate, kernel ratio per batch — automated from processing data.

items.title: Certification Compliance Tracker
items.desc: Digital audit trail for Organic, Halal, ISO 22000 — logs every input, every inspection date.

items.title: Sustainability Metrics
items.desc: Water usage, organic inputs, waste diversion, carbon footprint per harvest — measured, not estimated.

items.title: Automated Batch QR Codes
items.desc: Each shipment gets a unique QR code linking to its full traceability record — scannable by any buyer.

items.title: Supplier Traceability
items.desc: Track which cooperative farmer supplied which batch — full supply chain visibility.

items.title: Processing Line Monitoring
items.desc: Roasting temperature, shelling yield, grading results — every machine, every batch.

items.title: Inventory Management
items.desc: Raw nuts, WIP, finished goods by batch, location, and age — FIFO tracking automated.

items.title: Export Documentation Generator
items.desc: Auto-generate COO, Phyto, SGS, and invoice from batch data — hours saved per shipment.

items.title: Buyer Portal
items.desc: Clients log in to view their order's full traceability, documents, and quality reports.

items.title: Multi-Farm Support
items.desc: Extend Farm OS to partner cooperatives — one platform, multiple farms.

items.title: Real-Time Pricing Engine
items.desc: Track RCN market prices plus processing costs to calculate margins per batch.

items.title: IoT Sensor Integration
items.desc: Soil moisture, weather stations, automated irrigation alerts — precision agriculture.
